title: GrowthBook reasons carousel
description: A big heading, then a slim vertical tab list on the left (the active tab is a white slip with the multicolour rail on its edge; the others carry a tiny mono prefix) and a row of tall gradient cards (navy-to-blue, violet, teal) that runs off the right edge of the page and advances by itself. On phones the tabs become a horizontal row with a violet underline.
notes: the cards force the dark tokens (class dark); tones use background→chart-2, card→primary and chart-3→highlight
each card has an art slot (bottom-left, ~150px); empty ones show a soft translucent square
the card row bleeds to the window's right edge, so the block clips horizontal overflow
